integration_issues.issue: Logged-in client with lang=es and Spanish labels (Galería, Guardadas) navigates to /banner-gallery and /my-saved (English aliases) instead of /galeria-banners and /mis-guardadas. Pages still load correctly via server-side route aliases, isActive() handles both prefixes. Same code path: `lang === 'en' ? '/banner-gallery' : '/galeria-banners'` in BottomNav.jsx lines 99-100 — suggests lang was 'en' at first render before I18nContext rehydrated to 'es'. Either eager-default to 'es' or read URL/cookie before paint to avoid the mismatch.

rca of the issue: Cosmetic path-language mismatch in BottomNav: galleryPath and savedPath are computed using `lang === 'en' ? ... : ...` at render time. If I18nContext hasn't fully hydrated when BottomNav first mounts, lang may briefly read 'en' (default). After hydration to 'es', the labels update via t(), but the Link `to` prop on the already-rendered items may retain the en path until next re-render. Fix: read lang from localStorage/cookie synchronously in the context's initial state, or memo the paths with useMemo([lang]) to force re-eval. Non-blocking because backend has both /galeria-banners ↔ /banner-gallery and /mis-guardadas ↔ /my-saved aliases.
